name: Brahma TOPG zapper unvalidated call
summary: The Brahma TOPG Zapper's zapIn called a caller-supplied swapTarget with caller-supplied calldata. The attacker passed its own contract as the input token and USDC.transferFrom calldata, moving USDC from three accounts that had approved the Zapper to itself.
notes: zapIn reverts unless vault.zapper() is the Zapper; governance granted it that role (the vault's authorised zapper) after deployment, so the exploitable state dates from that grant (rule 8 role/registry grant), not from the deployment.
Every earlier zapIn was the user pulling its own funds; none after the anchor. Loss is the three victims' USDC, priced by DefiLlama at block time (USDC traded slightly below par that day).
